message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout. As my kids started to panic, I calmly reached for my trusty flashlights and power banks. It felt pretty smug to pull out my prep stash while they fumbled around looking for candles. We ended up playing charades in the glow of our lanterns, and I couldn’t help but smile at how prepared I was. Sometimes, a little foresight makes those unexpected moments turn into family fun instead of chaos. Ever had a surprise blackout that turned into a memorable night?
